searchText: Fwiw to lighthouse peeps: while syncing nimbus on devnet-5 , i'm connecting to a LH node (16Uiu2HAmDoLmZYb2S36Z92xy1kZi2A6KvNWNeJVJ3DPvwvVwtxmJ) and making successive blocks and blobs by range requests. After around 64 requests, I get disconnected with reason 250 (`GoodbyeReason::BadScore`). I guess it doesn't like the rapid succession of requests - is this expected? (also should I be using <#892088344438255616> for this ?) our peer scoring for blobs is a bit WIP right now, will check it out <gakonst> Is there a blobpool spec beyond Peter’s original guidance for EL? Might have missed it
